ayahs.tl: Yaa-Seeen
ayahs.en: Ya, Seen.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡقُرۡاٰنِ الۡحَكِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wal-Qur-aanil-Hakeem
ayahs.en: By the wise Qur'an.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّكَ لَمِنَ الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaka laminal mursaleen
ayahs.en: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,

ayahs.ar: عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍؕ‏
ayahs.tl: 'Alaa Siraatim Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: On a straight path.

ayahs.ar: تَنۡزِيۡلَ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الرَّحِيۡمِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Tanzeelal 'Azeezir Raheem
ayahs.en: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,

ayahs.ar: لِتُنۡذِرَ قَوۡمًا مَّا٘ اُنۡذِرَ اٰبَآؤُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ غٰفِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Litunzira qawmam maaa unzira aabaaa'uhum fahum ghaafiloon
ayahs.en: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.

ayahs.ar: لَقَدۡ حَقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلٰ٘ي اَكۡثَرِهِمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laqad haqqal qawlu 'alaaa aksarihim fahum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا جَعَلۡنَا فِيۡ٘ اَعۡنَاقِهِمۡ اَغۡلٰلًا فَهِيَ اِلَي الۡاَذۡقَانِ فَهُمۡ مُّقۡمَحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innaa ja'alnaa feee a'naaqihim aghlaalan fahiya ilal azqaani fahum muqmahoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ سَدًّا وَّمِنۡ خَلۡفِهِمۡ سَدًّا فَاَغۡشَيۡنٰهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnaa mim baini aydeehim saddanw-wa min khalfihim saddan fa aghshai naahum fahum laa yubsiroon
ayahs.en: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.

ayahs.ar: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَاَنۡذَرۡتَهُمۡ اَمۡ لَمۡ تُنۡذِرۡهُمۡ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa sawaaa'un 'alaihim 'a-anzartahum am lam tunzirhum laa yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا تُنۡذِرُ مَنِ اتَّبَعَ الذِّكۡرَ وَخَشِيَ الرَّحۡمٰنَ بِالۡغَيۡبِۚ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِمَغۡفِرَةٍ وَّاَجۡرٍ كَرِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa tunziru manit taba 'az-Zikra wa khashiyar Rahmaana bilghaib, fabashshirhu bimaghfiratinw-wa ajrin kareem
ayahs.en: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِ الۡمَوۡتٰي وَنَكۡتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوۡا وَاٰثَارَهُمۡؕؔ وَكُلَّ شَيۡءٍ اَحۡصَيۡنٰهُ فِيۡ٘ اِمَامٍ مُّبِيۡنٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innaa Nahnu nuhyil mawtaa wa naktubu maa qaddamoo wa aasaarahum; wa kulla shai'in ahsainaahu feee Imaamim Mubeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.

ayahs.ar: وَاضۡرِبۡ لَهُمۡ مَّثَلًا اَصۡحٰبَ الۡقَرۡيَةِۘ اِذۡ جَآءَهَا الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wadrib lahum masalan Ashaabal Qaryatih; iz jaaa'ahal mursaloon
ayahs.en: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -

ayahs.ar: اِذۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡهِمُ اثۡنَيۡنِ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُمَا فَعَزَّزۡنَا بِثَالِثٍ فَقَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ مُّرۡسَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Iz arsalnaaa ilaihimusnaini fakazzaboohumaa fa'azzaznaa bisaalisin faqaalooo innaaa ilaikum mursaloon
ayahs.en: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا مَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثۡلُنَاۙ وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍۙ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا تَكۡذِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo maaa antum illaa basharum mislunaa wa maaa anzalar Rahmaanu min shai'in in antum illaa takziboon
ayahs.en: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا رَبُّنَا يَعۡلَمُ اِنَّا٘ اِلَيۡكُمۡ لَمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo Rabbunaa ya'lamu innaaa ilaikum lamursaloon
ayahs.en: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَا٘ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa 'alainaaa illal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.en: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّا تَطَيَّرۡنَا بِكُمۡۚ لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ تَنۡتَهُوۡا لَنَرۡجُمَنَّكُمۡ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُمۡ مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo innaa tataiyarnaa bikum la'il-lam tantahoo lanar jumannakum wa la-yamassan nakum minnaa 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا طَآئِرُكُمۡ مَّعَكُمۡؕ اَئِنۡ ذُكِّرۡتُمۡؕ بَلۡ اَنۡتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ مُّسۡرِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo taaa'irukum ma'akum; a'in zukkirtum; bal antum qawmum musrifoon
ayahs.en: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."

ayahs.ar: وَجَآءَ مِنۡ اَقۡصَا الۡمَدِيۡنَةِ رَجُلٌ يَّسۡعٰيؗ قَالَ يٰقَوۡمِ اتَّبِعُوا الۡمُرۡسَلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa jaaa'a min aqsal madeenati rajuluny yas'aa qaala yaa qawmit tabi'ul mursaleen
ayahs.en: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.

ayahs.ar: اتَّبِعُوۡا مَنۡ لَّا يَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ اَجۡرًا وَّهُمۡ مُّهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ittabi'oo mal-laa yas'alukum ajranw-wa hum muhtadoon
ayahs.en: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا لِيَ لَا٘ اَعۡبُدُ الَّذِيۡ فَطَرَنِيۡ وَاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa liya laaa a'budul lazee fataranee wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?

ayahs.ar: ءَاَتَّخِذُ مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ٘ اٰلِهَةً اِنۡ يُّرِدۡنِ الرَّحۡمٰنُ بِضُرٍّ لَّا تُغۡنِ عَنِّيۡ شَفَاعَتُهُمۡ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يُنۡقِذُوۡنِۚ‏
ayahs.tl: 'A-attakhizu min dooniheee aalihatan iny-yuridnir Rahmaanu bidurril-laa tughni 'annee shafaa 'atuhum shai 'anw-wa laa yunqizoon
ayahs.en: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اِذًا لَّفِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Inneee izal-lafee dalaa-lim-mubeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.

ayahs.ar: اِنِّيۡ٘ اٰمَنۡتُ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَاسۡمَعُوۡنِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Inneee aamantu bi Rabbikum fasma'oon
ayahs.en: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."

ayahs.ar: قِيۡلَ ادۡخُلِ الۡجَنَّةَؕ قَالَ يٰلَيۡتَ قَوۡمِيۡ يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qeelad khulil Jannnah; qaala yaa laita qawmee ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know

ayahs.ar: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِيۡ رَبِّيۡ وَجَعَلَنِيۡ مِنَ الۡمُكۡرَمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bimaa ghafara lee Rabbee wa ja'alanee minal mukrameen
ayahs.en: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلٰي قَوۡمِهٖ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهٖ مِنۡ جُنۡدٍ مِّنَ السَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنۡزِلِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaa qawmihee mim ba'dihee min jundim minas-samaaa'i wa maa kunnaa munzileen
ayahs.en: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ خٰمِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum khaamidoon
ayahs.en: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.

ayahs.ar: يٰحَسۡرَةً عَلَي الۡعِبَادِۚ࣠ مَا يَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ رَّسُوۡلٍ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yaa hasratan 'alal 'ibaad; maa yaateehim mir Rasoolin illaa kaanoo bihee yastahzi 'oon
ayahs.en: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا كَمۡ اَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقُرُوۡنِ اَنَّهُمۡ اِلَيۡهِمۡ لَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alam yaraw kam ahlak naa qablahum minal qurooni annahum ilaihim laa yarji'oon
ayahs.en: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ كُلٌّ لَّمَّا جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa in kullul lammaa jamee'ul-ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.en: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الۡاَرۡضُ الۡمَيۡتَةُۚۖ اَحۡيَيۡنٰهَا وَاَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبًّا فَمِنۡهُ يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Aayatul lahumul ardul maitatu ahyainaahaa wa akhrajnaa minhaa habban faminhu yaakuloon
ayahs.en: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.

ayahs.ar: وَجَعَلۡنَا فِيۡهَا جَنّٰتٍ مِّنۡ نَّخِيۡلٍ وَّاَعۡنَابٍ وَّفَجَّرۡنَا فِيۡهَا مِنَ الۡعُيُوۡنِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ja'alnaa feehaa jannaatim min nakheelinw wa a'naabinw wa fajjarnaa feeha minal 'uyoon
ayahs.en: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -

ayahs.ar: لِيَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡ ثَمَرِهٖۙ وَمَا عَمِلَتۡهُ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Liyaakuloo min samarihee wa maa 'amilat-hu aideehim; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.en: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.ar: سُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ الۡاَزۡوَاجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۭۡ بِتُ الۡاَرۡضُ وَمِنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Subhaanal lazee khalaqal azwaaja kullahaa mimmaa tumbitul ardu wa min anfusihim wa mimmaa laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمُ الَّيۡلُۚۖ نَسۡلَخُ مِنۡهُ النَّهَارَ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مُّظۡلِمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Aayatul lahumul lailu naslakhu minhun nahaara fa-izaa hum muzlimoon
ayahs.en: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.

ayahs.ar: وَالشَّمۡسُ تَجۡرِيۡ لِمُسۡتَقَرٍّ لَّهَاؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقۡدِيۡرُ الۡعَزِيۡزِ الۡعَلِيۡمِؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wash-shamsu tajree limustaqarril lahaa; zaalika taqdeerul 'Azeezil Aleem
ayahs.en: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتّٰي عَادَ كَالۡعُرۡجُوۡنِ الۡقَدِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Walqamara qaddarnaahu manaazila hattaa 'aada kal'ur joonil qadeem
ayahs.en: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.

ayahs.ar: لَا الشَّمۡسُ يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهَا٘ اَنۡ تُدۡرِكَ الۡقَمَرَ وَلَا الَّيۡلُ سَابِقُ النَّهَارِؕ وَكُلٌّ فِيۡ فَلَكٍ يَّسۡبَحُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Lash shamsu yambaghee lahaaa an tudrikal qamara wa lal lailu saabiqun nahaar; wa kullun fee falaki yasbahoon
ayahs.en: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰيَةٌ لَّهُمۡ اَنَّا حَمَلۡنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ فِي الۡفُلۡكِ الۡمَشۡحُوۡنِۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa Aayatul lahum annaa hamalnaa zurriyatahum fil fulkil mashhoon
ayahs.en: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.

ayahs.ar: وَخَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مِّثۡلِهٖ مَا يَرۡكَبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa khalaqnaa lahum mim-mislihee maa yarkaboon
ayahs.en: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ نَّشَاۡ نُغۡرِقۡهُمۡ فَلَا صَرِيۡخَ لَهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡقَذُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa in nashaa nughriqhum falaa sareekha lahum wa laa hum yunqazoon
ayahs.en: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved

ayahs.ar: اِلَّا رَحۡمَةً مِّنَّا وَمَتَاعًا اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Illaa rahmatam minnaa wa mataa'an ilaa heen
ayahs.en: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمُ اتَّقُوۡا مَا بَيۡنَ اَيۡدِيۡكُمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُرۡحَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahumuttaqoo maa baina aideekum wa maa khalfakum la'allakum turhamoon
ayahs.en: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "

ayahs.ar: وَمَا تَاۡتِيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اٰيَةٍ مِّنۡ اٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ اِلَّا كَانُوۡا عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa taateehim min aayatim min ayataati Rabbihim illaa kaanoo 'anhaa mu'rideen
ayahs.en: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ اَنۡفِقُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُۙ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لِلَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡ٘ا اَنُطۡعِمُ مَنۡ لَّوۡ يَشَآءُ اللّٰهُ اَطۡعَمَهٗ٘ࣗۖ اِنۡ اَنۡتُمۡ اِلَّا فِيۡ ضَلٰلٍ مُّبِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahum anfiqoo mimmaa razaqakumul laahu qaalal lazeena kafaroo lillazeena aamanooo anut'imu mal-law yashaaa'ul laahu at'amahooo in antum illaa fee dalaalim mubeen
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."

ayahs.ar: وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الۡوَعۡدُ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰدِقِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaqooloona mataa haazal wa'du in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

ayahs.ar: مَا يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً تَاۡخُذُهُمۡ وَهُمۡ يَخِصِّمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Maa yanzuroona illaa saihatanw waahidatan taa khuzuhum wa hum yakhissimoon
ayahs.en: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ تَوۡصِيَةً وَّلَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اَهۡلِهِمۡ يَرۡجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Falaa yastatee'oona taw siyatanw-wa laaa ilaaa ahlihim yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.

ayahs.ar: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّوۡرِ فَاِذَا هُمۡ مِّنَ الۡاَجۡدَاثِ اِلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَنۡسِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa nufikha fis-soori faizaa hum minal ajdaasi ilaa Rabbihim yansiloon
ayahs.en: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.

ayahs.ar: قَالُوۡا يٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۭۡ بَعَثَنَا مِنۡ مَّرۡقَدِنَاۘࣝ࣠ هٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ الرَّحۡمٰنُ وَصَدَقَ الۡمُرۡسَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qaaloo yaa wailanaa mam ba'asanaa mim marqadinaa; haaza maa wa'adar Rahmanu wa sadaqal mursaloon
ayahs.en: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ كَانَتۡ اِلَّا صَيۡحَةً وَّاحِدَةً فَاِذَا هُمۡ جَمِيۡعٌ لَّدَيۡنَا مُحۡضَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: In kaanat illaa saihatanw waahidatan fa-izaa hum jamee'ul ladainaa muhdaroon
ayahs.en: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.

ayahs.ar: فَالۡيَوۡمَ لَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٌ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ اِلَّا مَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fal-Yawma laa tuzlamu nafsun shai'anw-wa laa tujzawna illaa maa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّةِ الۡيَوۡمَ فِيۡ شُغُلٍ فٰكِهُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna Ashaabal jannatil Yawma fee shughulin faakihoon
ayahs.en: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -

ayahs.ar: هُمۡ وَاَزۡوَاجُهُمۡ فِيۡ ظِلٰلٍ عَلَي الۡاَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Hum wa azwaajuhum fee zilaalin 'alal araaa'iki muttaki'oon
ayahs.en: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.

ayahs.ar: لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا فَاكِهَةٌ وَّلَهُمۡ مَّا يَدَّعُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Lahum feehaa faakiha tunw-wa lahum maa yadda'oon
ayahs.en: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]

ayahs.ar: سَلٰمٌࣞ قَوۡلًا مِّنۡ رَّبٍّ رَّحِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Salaamun qawlam mir Rabbir Raheem
ayahs.en: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.

ayahs.ar: وَامۡتَازُوا الۡيَوۡمَ اَيُّهَا الۡمُجۡرِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wamtaazul Yawma ayyuhal mujrimoon
ayahs.en: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ اَعۡهَدۡ اِلَيۡكُمۡ يٰبَنِيۡ٘ اٰدَمَ اَنۡ لَّا تَعۡبُدُوا الشَّيۡطٰنَۚ اِنَّهٗ لَكُمۡ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Alam a'had ilaikum yaa Baneee Aadama al-laa ta'budush Shaitaana innahoo lakum 'aduwwum mubeen
ayahs.en: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -

ayahs.ar: وَّاَنِ اعۡبُدُوۡنِيۡؕؔ هٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa ani'budoonee; haazaa Siraatum Mustaqeem
ayahs.en: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ اَضَلَّ مِنۡكُمۡ جِبِلًّا كَثِيۡرًاؕ اَفَلَمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا تَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad adalla minkum jibillan kaseeraa; afalam takoonoo ta'qiloon
ayahs.en: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?

ayahs.ar: هٰذِهٖ جَهَنَّمُ الَّتِيۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تُوۡعَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Haazihee Jahannamul latee kuntum too'adoon
ayahs.en: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.

ayahs.ar: اِصۡلَوۡهَا الۡيَوۡمَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَكۡفُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Islawhal Yawma bimaa kuntum takfuroon
ayahs.en: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."

ayahs.ar: اَلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلٰ٘ي اَفۡوَاهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَا٘ اَيۡدِيۡهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ اَرۡجُلُهُمۡ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَكۡسِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Al-Yawma nakhtimu 'alaaa afwaahihim wa tukallimunaaa aideehim wa tashhadu arjuluhum bimaa kaanoo yaksiboon
ayahs.en: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسۡنَا عَلٰ٘ي اَعۡيُنِهِمۡ فَاسۡتَبَقُوا الصِّرَاطَ فَاَنّٰي يُبۡصِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law nashaaa'u lata masna 'alaaa aiyunihim fasta baqus-siraata fa-annaa yubsiroon
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخۡنٰهُمۡ عَلٰي مَكَانَتِهِمۡ فَمَا اسۡتَطَاعُوۡا مُضِيًّا وَّلَا يَرۡجِعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa law nashaaa'u lamasakhnaahum 'alaa makaanatihim famas-tataa'oo mudiyyanw-wa laa yarji'oon
ayahs.en: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.

ayahs.ar: وَمَنۡ نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي الۡخَلۡقِؕ اَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa man nu 'ammirhu nunakkishu fil-khalq; afalaa ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?

ayahs.ar: وَمَا عَلَّمۡنٰهُ الشِّعۡرَ وَمَا يَنۭۡ بَغِيۡ لَهٗؕ اِنۡ هُوَ اِلَّا ذِكۡرٌ وَّقُرۡاٰنٌ مُّبِيۡنٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa 'allamnaahush shi'ra wa maa yambaghee lah; in huwa illaa zikrunw-wa Qur-aanum mubeen
ayahs.en: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an

ayahs.ar: لِّيُنۡذِرَ مَنۡ كَانَ حَيًّا وَّيَحِقَّ الۡقَوۡلُ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Liyunzira man kaana haiyanw-wa yahiqqal qawlu 'alal-kaafireen
ayahs.en: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اَنَّا خَلَقۡنَا لَهُمۡ مِّمَّا عَمِلَتۡ اَيۡدِيۡنَا٘ اَنۡعَامًا فَهُمۡ لَهَا مٰلِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yaraw annaa khalaqnaa lahum mimmaa 'amilat aideenaaa an'aaman fahum lahaa maalikoon
ayahs.en: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?

ayahs.ar: وَذَلَّلۡنٰهَا لَهُمۡ فَمِنۡهَا رَكُوۡبُهُمۡ وَمِنۡهَا يَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa zallalnaahaa lahum faminhaa rakoobuhum wa minhaa yaakuloon
ayahs.en: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.

ayahs.ar: وَلَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَنَافِعُ وَمَشَارِبُؕ اَفَلَا يَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lahum feehaa manaa fi'u wa mashaarib; afalaa yashkuroon
ayahs.en: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?

ayahs.ar: وَاتَّخَذُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ اٰلِهَةً لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يُنۡصَرُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wattakhazoo min doonil laahi aalihatal la'allahum yunsaroon
ayahs.en: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.

ayahs.ar: لَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَ نَصۡرَهُمۡ وَهُمۡ لَهُمۡ جُنۡدٌ مُّحۡضَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa yastatee'oona nasrahum wa hum lahum jundum muhdaroon
ayahs.en: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا يَحۡزُنۡكَ قَوۡلُهُمۡۘ اِنَّا نَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falaa yahzunka qawluhum; innaa na'lamu maa yusirroona wa maa yu'linoon
ayahs.en: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَ الۡاِنۡسَانُ اَنَّا خَلَقۡنٰهُ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Awalam yaral insaanu annaa khalaqnaahu min nutfatin fa-izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
ayahs.en: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?

ayahs.ar: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًا وَّنَسِيَ خَلۡقَهٗؕ قَالَ مَنۡ يُّحۡيِ الۡعِظَامَ وَهِيَ رَمِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa daraba lanaa maslanw-wa nasiya khalqahoo qaala mai-yuhyil'izaama wa hiya rameem
ayahs.en: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ يُحۡيِيۡهَا الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡشَاَهَا٘ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍؕ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلۡقٍ عَلِيۡمُۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Qul yuh yeehal lazeee ansha ahaaa awwala marrah; wa Huwa bikulli khalqin 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."

ayahs.ar: اِۨلَّذِيۡ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الشَّجَرِ الۡاَخۡضَرِ نَارًا فَاِذَا٘ اَنۡتُمۡ مِّنۡهُ تُوۡقِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazee ja'ala lakum minash shajaril akhdari naaran fa-izaaa antum minhu tooqidoon
ayahs.en: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَيۡسَ الَّذِيۡ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِقٰدِرٍ عَلٰ٘ي اَنۡ يَّخۡلُقَ مِثۡلَهُمۡؕؔ بَلٰيࣗ وَهُوَ الۡخَلّٰقُ الۡعَلِيۡمُ
ayahs.tl: Awa laisal lazee khalaqas samaawaati wal arda biqaadirin 'alaaa ai-yakhluqa mislahum; balaa wa Huwal Khallaaqul 'Aleem
ayahs.en: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا٘ اَمۡرُهٗ٘ اِذَا٘ اَرَادَ شَيۡـًٔا اَنۡ يَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa amruhooo izaaa araada shai'an ai-yaqoola lahoo kun fa-yakoon
ayahs.en: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.ar: فَسُبۡحٰنَ الَّذِيۡ بِيَدِهٖ مَلَكُوۡتُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّاِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa Subhaanal lazee biyadihee malakootu kulli shai-inw-wa ilaihi turja'oon
ayahs.en: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
